Purpose: The PBS cluster facts every physics campaign of coupon-accuracy-assessment-20260913 ran with (physics-01..-13, gallery-05/06/06b/10, the decision-64a device library): one exclusive 192-vCPU Graviton4 node, 192 MPI ranks through the bounded mpiexec wrapper, a 6 h walltime with the runner deadline 15 min inside it, the frozen response-archive executable under the remote root. `coupon-library qualify` reads it (default: this file; --cluster-profile overrides) and never hard-codes any of it; the host and the remote root come from --remote HOST:ROOT. The instance type is chosen per job from Instances by the estimated Palace peak (InstanceRule; USER decision 2026-09-22: m8g.48xlarge default, r8g.48xlarge fallback; every campaign before that decision ran on r8g.48xlarge).
Name: soca-green normal-g m8g.48xlarge (r8g.48xlarge fallback)

Instances.NodeGiBOrigin: measured MemTotal 797,242,068,992 B of the first m8g.48xlarge job's node (PBS 47537, library-device-thin-01 2-edge thin worker-1, 2026-09-23; MemAvailable at the preflight 746,798,010,368 B = 695.5 GiB against the 460.8 GiB guard)
measured MemTotal of the physics campaigns' nodes

InstanceRule: a job runs on the first instance of Instances whose MemoryFitFraction x MemoryGiB holds the job's largest estimated Palace peak (the stage estimates' GB / the cost model's PalaceGBPerGiB): m8g.48xlarge (768 GiB, 192 Graviton4 vCPUs) is the default, r8g.48xlarge (1,536 GiB) the fallback for an estimated peak above 0.6 x 768 = 460.8 GiB (the device library's largest estimate is 338 GB, 7f03's p5 control; measured node peaks <= ~240 GiB; the streaming reducer ~34 GB); c8g.48xlarge (384 GiB) is deliberately absent - not safe for the p5 control stages of the largest coupons (USER decision 2026-09-22). The plan records the chosen instance (Instance) and its admission guard MinimumMemAvailableBytes = MemoryFitFraction x MemoryGiB, checked by run_stages before the first stage; the job script's #PBS -l instance_type is the chosen type
